question_text: Find the next: Z, Y, X, W, ___?

hint_ladder.title: Orient Yourself
hint_ladder.text: This is a letter sequence. Say the letters out loud: Z, Y, X, W. Saan papunta? Paatras sa alphabet, sunod-sunod.

hint_ladder.title: The Simple Rule
hint_ladder.text: Each letter is the one before it. So W is followed by V. Isipin mo 'yung reverse alphabet, parang jeepney route numbers na pababa.

hint_ladder.title: Apply It Now
hint_ladder.text: From W, one step back gives V. Huwag kang lalaktaw—kung hindi constant, magulo. Check mo na hanggang dulo, V ang sagot.

hint_ladder.title: Almost There
hint_ladder.text: Kabisaduhin ang reverse alphabet: Z, Y, X, W, V, U, T, S... The sequence is just reading off one letter at a time. So after W comes V.

A.text: Correct. One step paatras from W lands on V. Walang skip, sunod-sunod lang sa reverse alphabet.

B.text: You might have chosen U because you assumed a skip, pero the step is exactly one letter. V muna bago U.

C.text: You might have chosen T because you took three steps back, pero constant one-step lang. Hindi lumalaki agad.

D.text: You might have chosen S because you jumped too far, pero huwag mag-madali. The pattern is just reverse order, isa-isa.

next_time_rule: Sa letter sequences, alamin ang step size. I-recite ang alphabet paatras o pasulong para malaman kung one step lang o nag-i-skip. Constant dapat.
deconstruct_text:
Imagine nasa tricycle terminal ka, pila ng mga tricycle paatras: una si Z, sunod Y, X, W. Ganyan lang sila, sunod-sunod, walang pasaway na lumaktaw.

So ang pattern: bawat letra umuurong ng isang hakbang paatras. Pagkatapos ng W, natural na V ang susunod. Recite the reverse alphabet—Z, Y, X, W, V, U, T, S—makikita mo, effortless.

Ang mga maling sagot U, T, S, nag-skip kaya napahamak. 'Wag mag-assume na lumalaktaw; constant ang step. Stick to one backward step lang.
